translated_title: Infrastructure Ministry: The Largest Investment in History Is Already Underway

meta_description: Roads, 3,000 km of new rail and 62 upgraded airports will create nearly 4 million jobs, says Minister Esteva, tying Mexico's build-out to nearshoring.
